N30_legitimate_root_range.statement: For N=30 every legitimate nonempty root has r0<=14.

canonical_and_unit_free_constraints: Each canonical clause has width at most r0=8, hence L0<=8*m0.
Unit-free gives every clause width at least 2, hence L0>=2*m0.

r8_m5_degree2_composition.statement: In the sole r0=8,m0=5,L0=16 cell, either a degree-1 variable already exists, or every live variable has incidence degree exactly 2. In the latter case every pivot is raw-cap safe, and any mixed-polarity degree-2 pivot re-roots the residual at local size at most 26.
proof: All eight live variables occur at least once and their incidence sum is L0=16.
If no degree-1 variable exists, every incidence is at least 2, hence all eight incidences equal exactly 2.
A degree-2 pivot is either pure, in which case frozen elimination is pure deletion, or has p=q=1.
For p=q=1 the proved whole-state generic raw bound is B_x=s+p*q-2p-2q+(q-1)U_plus+(p-1)U_minus=s-3.
Here s=1+m0+L0=22, so B_x<=19, far below cap 900.
After eliminating one pivot, canonical output state_units are at most 19 and at most seven live variables remain, so the residual local encoding size is at most 19+7=26.
The already-proved N<=26 corridor completes the remaining ordinary-cap availability.
m0=1 would require L0=19 in one canonical clause over 9 variables, impossible because width<=9.
m0<=4 is covered by the existing small-clause invariant.
For m0>=3, L0<=17<18=2*r0, so degree-1 is forced; this overlaps and strengthens the m0=3,4 cases.

high_r_degree1_corridor.statement: For r0>=10, L0<=28-r0<2*r0 because 28<3*r0; hence a degree-1 pivot is forced.

degree1_reroot.statement: Every degree-1 elimination from N=30 re-roots at local size at most 26, inside the proved N<=26 corridor.

theorem.name: NO_RAW_CAP_RESCUE_REQUIRED_THROUGH_N30
theorem.statement: Inherit N<=29. At N=30, r0<=7 is covered by the existing recurrence; all r0>=10 roots force degree-1 pivots; r0=9 is closed by canonical width, small-clause, and degree-1 invariants; r0=8 is closed except for the single m0=5,L0=16 balanced cell, where the already-proved generic raw budget lemma forces a raw-safe degree-2 pivot and re-roots at local size at most 26. Therefore no legitimate N<=30 root requires v2/v3 because of ordinary raw-cap unavailability.

next_exact_target: Advance to N=31 with the same frozen grammar. Audit the r0=8 and r0=9 boundary cells using only the existing exact raw-budget, degree, sparse-clause, and reroot theorems.
